description: Official yt-dlp release metadata is staged for desktop targets. Installation remains disabled until the verified installer and runtime integration are complete.
notes: yt-dlp desktop URLs and SHA-256 values are copied from the official yt-dlp GitHub release metadata for tag 2026.10.26.
The yt-dlp tool remains disabled until the app can download, verify, install, and resolve the executable safely.
Android is intentionally not configured: the official Linux binaries are not assumed to be compatible with Android's runtime.
FFmpeg remains independently disabled and will be configured in its own implementation step.
Release entries are keyed by an explicit target identifier, for example windows-x86_64, linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, android-aarch64.
Do not populate this file with guessed URLs or placeholder digests; the updater must fail closed when a target entry is missing.
